title.zh-TW: 用量報表按派工額度分塊顯示，清楚列出對話消耗明細
title.en: Usage report groups task budgets into separate blocks with conversation-level details

body.zh-TW: 當你頻繁指派 AI 處理各類任務時，常常需要確認不同模型的配額到底耗費在哪些對話上。派工帳本原本採用七欄表格，現在改為「派工額度花在哪（最近 7 天）」，替 Codex 與每個 Antigravity 模型群組各自獨立分塊。⟦跟翻閱專案的請款帳本一樣，以前所有項目的開銷全擠在一張大表格裡，既難以對照個別上限，加總甚至還會莫名破表；現在各預算項目獨立成頁，清楚列出金額最高的前幾筆花費，對帳時便能逐筆核實。⟧每個區塊都會標出本週已用額度，並列出消耗最多的前五個派工對話，其餘對話寫成「另外 N 段」，剩下的用量歸入「其他（你直接用的，或沒對到派工紀錄）」。Antigravity 每個群組各自計算週額度，不再合併相加，避免舊表格加總超過 100% 的情形；若 Codex 用量全在額度重置前發生，該區塊也會以一句話說明。
body.en: When you frequently assign AI different tasks, you often need to check which conversations have used up each model’s quota. The task ledger’s seven-column table has now been replaced with “Where your task budget went (last 7 days),” with separate blocks for Codex and each Antigravity model group. ⟦It works like reviewing a project’s expense ledger: previously, every item’s spending was crammed into one large table, making it hard to check against individual limits, and the totals could even inexplicably exceed the budget. Now each budget category has its own page listing the largest expenses, so you can verify them individually when reconciling the accounts.⟧ Each block shows the quota used this week and lists the top five task conversations by consumption. Remaining conversations appear as “N more conversations,” and the remaining usage goes under “Other (used directly by you, or unmatched to task records).” Each Antigravity group’s weekly quota is calculated separately instead of being added together, preventing the old table’s totals from exceeding 100%. If all Codex usage occurred before the quota reset, its block also explains that in a sentence.

items.original: **The usage report shows where each dispatch quota went.** The dispatch ledger's seven-column table is now "Where your dispatch quota went (last 7 days)": one block per quota, for Codex and each Antigravity model group, with how much of it is used this week, the conversations whose dispatched work used it (top five, then "N more"), and the rest as "Other (your own use, or no dispatch record found)". Antigravity groups each have their own weekly quota and are no longer added together; the old table could total more than 100%. When all of Codex's usage came before its reset, the block says so in one line.

title.zh-TW: Muse 週額度用盡正確歸屬，卡片依重置時間標記上限
title.en: Muse weekly quota exhaustion is correctly identified, with cards marking limits by reset time

body.zh-TW: 長時間使用 Muse 容易撞上用量限制，此時介面回報哪種額度見底，直接決定了你得等待多久。Muse 的五小時額度與週額度用完時，都會回傳相同的「Subscription quota exhausted」（訂閱額度已耗盡）錯誤訊息。⟦像在手機門市查詢多個方案用量，以前不管哪種配額見底，簡訊都只通報短週期方案已滿，明明是週方案用盡卻標註三天後重置；現在若重置間隔拉長，介面便會精準指出真正用滿的是長週期配額，並如實標上恢復時間。⟧舊版 v0.34.5 一律將該錯誤判定為五小時額度耗盡，導致週額度用完時，卡片顯示「工作階段 100%、3 天後重置」，而週額度那列仍停在舊數字。現在只要重置時間超過 5 小時，卡片就會把週額度記錄為 100%，並帶上正確的重置時間。
body.en: Extended use of Muse can hit usage limits, and which quota the interface reports as exhausted directly determines how long you need to wait. Muse returns the same “Subscription quota exhausted” error message whether its five-hour or weekly quota runs out. ⟦Imagine checking usage across several plans at a mobile phone store. Previously, whichever quota ran out, the text message only reported that the short-cycle plan was full. Even when the weekly plan was exhausted, it showed a reset in three days. Now, if the reset interval is longer, the interface accurately identifies the longer-cycle quota as the one that is full and shows its actual recovery time.⟧ The old v0.34.5 always treated this error as five-hour quota exhaustion. When the weekly quota ran out, the card therefore showed “Session 100%, resets in 3 days,” while the weekly quota row still displayed its previous value. Now, whenever the reset is more than 5 hours away, the card records the weekly quota as 100% and includes the correct reset time.

items.original: **The Muse card records a used-up weekly allowance as the weekly limit.** Muse sends the same "Subscription quota exhausted" error for both limits, and v0.34.5 always recorded it as the 5-hour window. A used-up week showed "Session 100%, resets in 3 days" while the weekly row kept an old reading. A reset more than 5 hours away now marks the weekly row as 100% with that reset time.

title.zh-TW: Wrapped 說明文字改為近一年，反映滾動 53 週數據
title.en: Wrapped description now says “over the past year” to reflect rolling 53-week data

body.zh-TW: 翻閱 Wrapped 的個人 AI 用量摘要時，介面標註的時間範圍會直接影響你對數據的理解。Wrapped 實際統計最近連續 53 週，說明文字現在寫成「近一年」，讓你知道這份回顧不是從今年一月一日起算。⟦好比查看運動手環的年累積步數，若沒看清楚統計期間，容易以為紀錄只從一月一日起算；標記成近一年，就能明白數據呈現的是最近一整年的連續走勢。⟧現在介面說明正式改為「近一年」（over the past year）。這項調整是因為 Wrapped 資料實際涵蓋滾動 53 週，並非單一曆年，改用近一年更能準確呈現這段跨度的真實用量。
body.en: When reviewing your personal AI usage summary in Wrapped, the time range shown in the interface directly affects how you interpret the data. Wrapped actually covers the most recent 53 consecutive weeks. Its description now says “over the past year,” making it clear that the review does not start on January 1 of the current year. ⟦Think of checking the yearly step total on a fitness tracker. If you overlook the reporting period, you might assume the record starts on January 1. Labeling it “over the past year” makes it clear that the data shows a continuous trend across the most recent full year.⟧ The interface description has now officially changed to “over the past year.” This adjustment reflects the fact that Wrapped’s data covers a rolling 53 weeks rather than a single calendar year, so “over the past year” more accurately describes the actual usage across that span.

items.original: **Wrapped captions say "over the past year".** The data covers a rolling 53 weeks, not the calendar year.
